# Core Hermit Terms of Use

_Effective September 29, 2026_

These Terms of Use ("Terms") apply to your use of the Core Hermit app ("Core Hermit" or the "App"). Your license to use the App is granted under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) (the "Standard EULA"). These Terms supplement the Standard EULA; if they conflict, the Standard EULA controls to the extent required. By using the App you agree to these Terms.

## 1. What the App does
Core Hermit lets you run and compare AI language models on your device, including Apple Intelligence and third-party open-weight models that you choose to download. The App does not use cloud AI services.

## 2. AI-generated content
Responses are generated automatically by AI models and may be inaccurate, incomplete, offensive, or otherwise objectionable. Responses do not represent the views of the developer. They are provided for general informational and entertainment purposes only and are **not professional advice** (including medical, legal, financial, or mental-health advice). You are solely responsible for evaluating responses and for any use you make of them.

## 3. Third-party models and content
Open models are developed and licensed by third parties. Core Hermit makes the listed models available through Apple's servers, and other models are downloaded from third-party services such as Hugging Face. Each model is subject to its own license and acceptable-use policy (see **AI Model Licenses**), which you agree to follow. If you download a model by entering its identifier yourself ("custom model"), you do so at your own risk; the developer does not review, control, or endorse custom models or their output. Apple Intelligence is provided by Apple and is subject to Apple's terms. The developer is not responsible for third-party models, services, or content.

## 4. Acceptable use
You agree not to use the App to:
- break any law or infringe anyone's rights;
- create content that exploits or harms minors, promotes violence or self-harm, harasses others, or facilitates fraud, weapons, or other serious harm;
- create or spread misleading content, including content impersonating real people;
- violate the license or use policy of any model you use (including Apple's Foundation Models acceptable use requirements, Google's Gemma prohibited use policy, and Meta's Llama Acceptable Use Policy).

## 5. Your content
You keep all rights to the prompts and documents you provide. Make sure you have the right to use any document you import. Because everything stays on your device, you are responsible for keeping backups of anything important.

## 6. Downloads and device resources
AI models can be large (hundreds of megabytes to several gigabytes). Downloads may use cellular data and incur carrier charges, and running models uses significant storage, memory, and battery and may make your device warm. Models may run slowly or not at all on some devices.
